rationale.policy: Each limit is a hard raw-byte/entry ceiling enforced by viteBudgetPlugin during the production build (Rollup generateBundle) and the Workbox precache manifest transform. One byte or one entry over any limit fails the build. Baselines are the current measured actuals plus a small (~4-5%) headroom so routine edits do not flap CI while a material regression is caught.
rationale.initialEntryBytes: Raw bytes of the synchronously loaded entry chunk (index-*.js), so code that only a lazy feature needs does not creep into every page load.
rationale.largestAssetBytes: Raw bytes of the largest single output file, currently the lazy beautiful-mermaid chunk, so no one file silently grows past what the precache and a cold install can carry.
rationale.totalOutputBytes: Sum of every emitted output file, so overall bundle bloat is caught whichever chunk it lands in.
rationale.precacheBytes: Sum of the Workbox precache manifest entry sizes, the offline app-shell weight a cold install downloads, which must stay bounded so install is fast and quota-safe.
rationale.precacheEntries: Number of precache manifest entries, so a newly split dependency family cannot add files to every install unnoticed.
rationale.mermaidOwnedBytes: Raw bytes of chunks wholly owned by the Mermaid module graph (Rollup module ownership, not file-name substrings), an explicit cap on a library that stays fully precached; ownership is all-or-nothing per chunk, so the cap cannot absorb unrelated code.
rationale.pdfjsOwnedBytes: Raw bytes of chunks wholly owned by the lazy PDF viewer graph (PdfViewer.tsx, react-pdf, pdfjs-dist); the pdf.js worker is an emitted asset outside the chunk graph and is bounded by the asset and total limits instead.
rationale.katexOwnedBytes: Raw bytes of chunks wholly owned by the lazy KaTeX graph, a single copy because pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides mermaid's transitive katex onto the app's own version.
rationale.beautifulMermaidOwnedBytes: Raw bytes of chunks wholly owned by the lazy beautiful-mermaid graph (the package, elkjs, entities and the app-side beautifulMermaid.ts barrel that names the chunk); package seeds anchor to a node_modules/ path segment so a worktree directory named after a package cannot match.
rationale.hljsOwnedBytes: Raw bytes of chunks wholly owned by the lazy highlight.js graph (CodeBlock.tsx's dynamic import of highlight.js/lib/common), which keeps its grammars out of the entry chunk.
